rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, theme toggle, modals) MUST contain data-testid in kebab-case format.
Must support prefers-reduced-motion to halt heavy loops or typing effects.
Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA standards in both dark and light modes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page or multi-view rich React portfolio with integrated client-side state / mock API handlers for admin panel and quote estimator.
Implement the theme switcher state cleanly using class toggling on the document element ('dark' vs 'light').
Use JetBrains Mono / monospace styling for metadata, tags, system headers, and git logs to reinforce the terminal/database aesthetic.
Make sure every section feels visually dense, precision-crafted, and functional.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, navigation items, cards, and modal triggers have data-testid attributes.
